question: Should this repository own automatic `main` to Cloudflare coordinator deployment through a `coordinator` GitHub Environment using `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, and should that deploy wait for the full Worker CI gate?
rationale: This changes production deployment ownership and grants a secret-bearing Action path; current main has no such workflow and history shows a prior deploy workflow was centralized away, so automation cannot safely choose the operator policy.

options.title: Approve gated repo-local deploy
options.body: Land this workflow after redacted Action-path proof and maintainer confirmation of environment reviewers, token scope, and CI-ordering expectations.

options.title: Require CI-dependent deployment
options.body: Ask for a workflow shape that runs only after the Worker CI job is green, trading a little deploy latency for stronger release safety.

options.title: Keep deployment external
options.body: Close or pause this PR if coordinator deployment is meant to remain centralized or manually operated outside this repository.

recommendation.title: Approve gated repo-local deploy
recommendation.body: Land this workflow after redacted Action-path proof and maintainer confirmation of environment reviewers, token scope, and CI-ordering expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the recent coordinator OOM fix/deploy context and most current Worker/deploy-history commits surfaced in the review.
